description: This file implements the RialtoConnector class, which manages application sessions, state changes, and environment configurations within the Rialto component. It includes functions for creating, resuming, suspending, and deactivating app sessions, as well as handling state change notifications and waiting for specific states.

classes.name: RialtoConnector
classes.description: A class that manages Rialto application sessions and server states.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RialtoConnector, setting up environment variables and creating the server manager service.

methods.name: createAppSession
methods.description: Creates a new application session with specified callsign, display name, and app ID.

methods.name: resumeSession
methods.description: Resumes an inactive session identified by callsign.

methods.name: suspendSession
methods.description: Suspends an active session identified by callsign.

methods.name: getCurrentAppState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the application session identified by callsign.

methods.name: deactivateSession
methods.description: Deactivates the session if it is in active or inactive state.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Handles notifications of state changes for applications.

methods.name: waitForStateChange
methods.description: Waits until a specific state is reached for an application, with a timeout.
